# stable-pretraining

> stable-pretraining is a PyTorch Lightning framework for self-supervised learning (SSL) research providing 9 composable forward functions and 30 full LightningModule method classes.

Lightning-based library for self-supervised learning without labels.
Implements 9 forward functions and 30 method classes across image and multimodal modalities.
Designed for researchers and practitioners who want a unified API for pretraining experiments.

Key concepts:
- **Forward functions** (`forward.py`): stateless step functions, one per SSL method.
  Signature: `(self, batch: dict[str, Any], stage: str) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]`
- **Module** (`module.py`): LightningModule wrapping any forward function with a backbone,
  optimizer, and callback hooks
- **Manager** (`manager.py`): top-level programmatic entry point; preferred over using
  Trainer directly

Implemented methods (forward functions): supervised_forward, simclr_forward, byol_forward,
vicreg_forward, barlow_twins_forward, swav_forward, nnclr_forward, dino_forward, dinov2_forward

Implemented methods (full LightningModule classes): BEiT, BYOL, BarlowTwins, CMAE, Data2Vec,
DINO, DINOv2, DINOv3, iBOT, iGPT, IJEPA, LeJEPA, MAE, MaskFeat, MIMRefiner, MoCov2, MoCov3,
MSN, NEPA, NNCLR, PIRL, SALT, SimCLR, SimMIM, SimSiam, SwAV, TiCO, VICReg, VICRegL, WMSE

## Docs

- [README](./README.md): Full quickstart, CLI reference, callback table, benchmark results
- [Methods catalog](./METHODS.md): Ground-truth index of all 30 method classes and 9 forward functions with loss classes, key callbacks, and paper citations
- [Agent instructions](./AGENTS.md): Authoritative instructions for AI agents working in this codebase — naming conventions, design decisions, how-to guides
- [Callback guide](./stable_pretraining/callbacks/README.md): Detailed usage guide for all callbacks with practical considerations
- [API: Module](./stable_pretraining/module.py): Core LightningModule
- [API: Manager](./stable_pretraining/manager.py): Programmatic entry point
- [API: Forward functions](./stable_pretraining/forward.py): All 9 forward functions
- [API: Callbacks](./stable_pretraining/callbacks/): Evaluation and training callbacks
- [Examples](./examples/): Runnable scripts and YAML configs
- [Rendered docs](https://galilai-group.github.io/stable-pretraining/): Full Sphinx documentation on GitHub Pages
- [Rendered API reference](https://galilai-group.github.io/stable-pretraining/api/): Module, class, and function reference

## Install

- Source: https://github.com/galilai-group/stable-pretraining

Note: stable-pretraining is not yet available on PyPI. Install from source:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/galilai-group/stable-pretraining.git
cd stable-pretraining
pip install -e .
```
